text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite weak overall sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 29 remains deeply into fear territory, though its recent uptick signals a tentative stabilization rather than capitulation. Bitcoin dominance holding steady near 57% combined with $53B in daily volume indicates measured risk appetite—traders are not aggressively fleeing to stablecoins, but conviction remains low.
